The abstract claims 'up to 18% reduction in catastrophic forgetting'. Table 3 shows an absolute reduction from 50.0% to 32.0% in average forgetting, which is an 18 percentage-point decrease, not an 18% relative reduction (which would be about 36%). The phrasing is ambiguous and misleading.
